name: Hyundai Glovis Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai Glovis Co., Ltd. engages in logistics, distribution, and shipping businesses. The company is involved in port service and transportation; C/C and VPC operation; global outsourcing; ship management; software development; supply business; and shipping finance. It also engages in Complete Knock Down (CKD), merchandise trading, and purchase and sale of used car businesses; smart logistics solution, hydrogen, and waste EV battery businesses; and automobile and bulk carrier business.
